title: documentation: rangeSlider demo display is buggy
body:
This is the current display of the rangeSlider on the documentation page:

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/11062911/397deba4-87b3-11e5-92fe-e10680be6eca.png)

As you can see, handlers are too big. I think I caused that when I loaded the `instantsearch.css` in the documentation page. We'll have to de-duplicate the rules between that file and `default-theme.css` that might be causing the issue.
